name: comp-269
blurb: Inline error alert with red icon.
description: Minimal inline alert for error messages using a red error icon from lucide-react. No dismiss action; purely informational for error display.
use_when: Displaying form validation errors or inline error messages without requiring user action.
avoid_when: Critical errors needing explicit user interaction or confirmation. Dense layouts with space constraints.
a11y: No ARIA alert role. Icon hidden from screen readers. Parent should implement role='alert' and aria-live='polite'.
